verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a public Invoicing API with a concrete REST reference (e.g., POST /v1/invoices/create_preview), official client libraries, a quickstart integration, invoice status transitions, and webhooks. Together these let an AI-native user drive invoicing entirely through code. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
